description_en: Queries all event targets of an event rule
description_zh: 查询一个事件规则的所有投递目标
kebab_example: aliyun eventbridge list-targets --event-bus-name my-event-bus --limit 10 --rule-name tf-testacc-rule --next-token 0 --arn acs:fc:cn-hangzhou:1186095474280000:services/fc-connector.a1/functions/event --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTargets

parameters.help_en: The name of the event bus
parameters.name: event_bus_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of returned entries in a call
parameters.help_zh: 限定每次返回的最大条数
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The name of the event rule
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: If you configure Limit and excess return values exist, this parameter is returned
parameters.help_zh: 当指定Limit时，如果还有多余的返回值则会返回NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the event rule
parameters.name: arn

Code.description_en:
The returned response code. Valid values:

Success: The request is successful.
Other codes: The request failed. For a list of error codes, see Error codes
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：
Success：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

NextToken.description_en: If excess return values exist, this parameter is returned
NextToken.description_zh: 如果还有多余的返回值则会返回NextToken

Concurrency.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent events allowed in the event target

Endpoint.description_en: The endpoint of the event target

ErrorsTolerance.description_en:
The fault tolerance policy. Valid values: ALL and NONE. 

ALL: Fault tolerance is allowed. If an error occurs in an event, event processing is not blocked. If the event fails to be sent after the maximum number of retries specified by the retry policy is reached, the event is delivered to the dead-letter queue or discarded based on your configurations. 
NONE: Fault tolerance is not allowed. If an error occurs in an event and the event fails to be sent after the maximum number of retries specified by the retry policy is reached, event processing is blocked
ErrorsTolerance.description_zh: 容错策略。取值说明如下： ALL：允许容错。允许异常容错，当异常发生时不会阻塞执行，超过重试策略后会根据配置将消息投递至死信队列或直接丢弃。 NONE：禁止容错。不允许容错，当异常发生并超过重试策略配置时会阻塞执行

EventBusName.description_en: The name of the event bus

Id.description_en: The ID of the event target

ParamList.description_en: The parameters that are configured for the event target

ResourceKey.description_en: The resource parameter of the event target

Template.description_zh: 事件目标参数模板样式

Value.description_en: The value of the event target parameter

RuleName.description_en: The name of the event rule

Type.description_zh: 事件目标类型。更多信息，请参见[事件目标参数]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183698.html）
